description: Tamkang Aerodynamic Loads Database for High-rise Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ahsan Kareem, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). The Tamkang Aerodynamic Loads Database for high-rise buildings comprises non-dimensional base moments/torsion coefficients and spectra for alongwind, acrosswind, and torsional directions in relation to the zero angle of attack. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (PDF, CSV, XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-x312-cf12. Keywords: Wind load, Wind tunnel experiment, High frequency base balance technique, aerodynamic database, high-rise building. Published 2025-01-22. Facility named: Wind Engineering Research Center, Tamkang University (TKU-WERC), Taiwan. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
